headline: Amalgamation/Merger
summary: Godrej Properties Limited's Board approved a Scheme of Amalgamation to merge its indirect wholly-owned subsidiary, Godrej Housing Projects Private Limited, into the company. The merger is subject to necessary approvals from the NCLT and other regulatory authorities. Godrej Properties currently holds 95% of the subsidiary's equity, with the remaining 5% held by another wholly-owned subsidiary.

headline: Outcome of Board Meeting
summary: UNO Minda Limited's Board approved a Scheme of Amalgamation to merge its subsidiary, Minda Onkyo India Pvt. Ltd., with itself. The merger is subject to statutory approvals, including from shareholders, creditors, and the National Company Law Tribunal. The company will file the scheme with stock exchanges as per SEBI regulations.

headline: Amalgamation/Merger
summary: UNO Minda Limited’s board has approved a scheme to amalgamate its subsidiary, Minda Onkyo India Pvt. Ltd., into the parent company. The merger is subject to regulatory, shareholder, and creditor approvals, including clearance from the National Company Law Tribunal. The move is considered a related-party transaction but does not require compliance with Section 188 of the Companies Act.

company: Jubilant Agri and Consumer Products Limited
headline: Copy of Newspaper Publication
summary: Jubilant Agri and Consumer Products Limited has informed the stock exchange about a newspaper publication regarding a notice for a meeting of equity shareholders and unsecured creditors, convened by the Hon'ble NCLT. The notice pertains to this scheduled meeting as part of the company's corporate proceedings.

headline: Other Restructuring
summary: BASF India’s Board has approved the closure of its sulfation and low-temperature reactor plants for the Care Chemicals business at the Dahej site, citing market overcapacities and margin pressure. The shutdown is expected by the end of 2026, pending approvals, while the business will continue other operations in India. In FY 2025-26, these plants contributed Rs. 542 crore, or 4% of the company’s total revenue.

headline: Agreements
summary: Belrise Industries Limited has approved the acquisition of the India tipper body business of Hyva (India) Pvt. Ltd. through a Business Transfer Agreement. The deal is valued at USD 5.65 million (approximately INR 543.88 million).

headline: Scheme of Arrangement
summary: Larsen & Toubro Limited has disclosed the voting results and Scrutinizer’s Report from the NCLT-convened equity shareholders’ meeting held on August 4, 2026, regarding its Scheme of Arrangement. The announcement provides a summary of the proceedings and confirms the outcome of the shareholder vote on the scheme.

headline: Shareholders meeting
summary: Larsen & Toubro has informed the exchange about the proceedings of its NCLT-convened shareholders' meeting held on August 4, 2026. The company has also submitted the Scrutinizer's report along with the voting results.

headline: Amalgamation/Merger
summary: Pondy Oxides & Chemicals Limited (POCL) has approved a scheme to amalgamate its wholly-owned subsidiary, Harsha Exito Engineering Private Limited (HEEPL), with itself. The merger aims to consolidate business operations, assets, and liabilities, and is subject to approval from the National Company Law Tribunal, shareholders, and creditors. The transaction is classified as a related party transaction but does not require compliance with Section 188 of the Companies Act, as no consideration is involved.

headline: Amalgamation/Merger
summary: Ventive Hospitality Limited has announced the merger of Sun Leisure (India) Private Limited into Soham Leisure Ventures Private Limited, as per SEBI Listing Regulations. The intimation was made under Regulation 30, detailing the amalgamation process. This move consolidates the company's leisure and hospitality assets under a single entity.

headline: Amalgamation/Merger
summary: Mahindra & Mahindra Financial Services Limited (MMFSL) has approved a scheme to merge its subsidiary, Mahindra Rural Housing Finance Limited (MRHFL), into itself. The merger aims to consolidate their lending operations into a single platform to simplify operations and enhance growth. The scheme is subject to regulatory approvals, with an appointed date of April 1, 2027.

headline: General Updates
summary: Adani Power Limited has received approval from the NCLT Ahmedabad for the amalgamation of its nine wholly-owned subsidiaries, with the scheme's appointed date set as April 1, 2025. The order was issued on August 4, 2026, though the process for one subsidiary, VIPL, remains pending before the NCLT Mumbai. The scheme will become effective once all required steps are completed, and the company will update the exchanges accordingly.

headline: Amalgamation/Merger
summary: Crisil Limited has completed the amalgamation of its wholly owned step-down subsidiaries, Crisil Canada Inc. and Crisil PriceMetrix Inc., into a single entity, Crisil PriceMetrix Inc., effective August 1, 2026. The Certificate of Amalgamation was received on August 5, 2026, marking the completion of all related formalities.

headline: Amalgamation/Merger
summary: TVS Motor Company has announced a composite scheme of amalgamation involving Home Credit India Finance, STPL Trading and Services, TVS Housing Finance, and TVS Credit Services, along with their shareholders. The merger aims to consolidate these entities under a unified structure. The proposal has been communicated to the stock exchange.

headline: Amalgamation/Merger
summary: TVS Holdings has announced that its subsidiary, Home Credit India Finance, along with other group entities, has approved a composite scheme of amalgamation. The scheme involves merging STPL Trading and Services and TVS Housing Finance into Home Credit India, which will then merge into TVS Credit Services. The merger is subject to regulatory approvals from the RBI, CCI, stock exchanges, and the NCLT.

headline: Amalgamation/Merger
summary: Aurobindo Pharma announced that its Board approved a proposal to file a Scheme of Amalgamation with the NCLT, merging two step-down subsidiaries, Eugia Steriles and Eugia SEZ, into its wholly-owned subsidiary, Eugia Pharma Specialities. The consolidation aims to simplify the group structure, reduce overheads, and achieve synergy benefits by merging three companies engaged in manufacturing injectable pharmaceuticals. As the merger involves only wholly-owned subsidiaries, no consideration is involved, and the company's shareholding pattern remains unchanged.

headline: Amalgamation/Merger
summary: The Sandesh Limited's Board approved the Scheme of Amalgamation to merge its subsidiary, Sandesh Digital Private Limited, into the company, subject to regulatory approvals. Additionally, the Board approved the unaudited financial results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, and fixed August 14, 2026, as the record date for the final dividend of Rs. 5 per share. The Board also approved the continued appointment of Non-Executive Director Smt. Pannaben F. Patel beyond the age of 75, pending shareholder approval.

headline: Scheme of Arrangement
summary: Marathon Nextgen Realty Limited has announced that, per an NCLT order dated July 2, 2026, it will hold separate meetings for its Equity Shareholders and Unsecured Creditors on September 7, 2026, at 11:00 a.m. and 12:30 p.m., respectively. These meetings are convened to consider and approve the company's Scheme of Arrangement.

headline: Shareholders meeting
summary: Marathon Nextgen Realty Limited has informed the exchange of a creditors' meeting scheduled for September 7, 2026, at 12:30 p.m. This meeting, convened by the NCLT Mumbai Bench, is for the company's unsecured creditors. The notice follows an NCLT order dated July 2, 2026.

headline: Shareholders meeting
summary: Marathon Nextgen Realty Limited has informed the exchange of a shareholders' meeting scheduled for September 7, 2026, at 11:00 a.m. The meeting is being convened as per the order of the National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT), Mumbai Bench, dated July 2, 2026.

headline: Shareholders meeting
summary: Refex Industries Limited has informed the stock exchanges about the proceedings of its NCLT-convened meetings with equity shareholders, secured creditors, and unsecured creditors, held on August 5, 2026. The intimation was made under Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Regulations. No specific outcomes or resolutions were disclosed in the announcement.

headline: News Verification
summary: The exchange has requested clarification from Vedanta Aluminium Metal Limited regarding a news report claiming the company plans to raise Rs 13,500 crore from Axis, HDFC, and ICICI Bank post-demerger. The company’s official response is still pending.

headline: News Verification
summary: Vedanta Aluminium Metal Limited clarified to the exchange regarding a news report claiming it would raise Rs 13,500 crore from Axis, HDFC, and ICICI Bank post-demerger. The company’s official response to the exchange’s query is attached in the announcement. No further details on the clarification’s content were provided in the summary.

company: Swan Defence and Heavy Industries Limited
headline: General Updates
summary: Swan Defence and Heavy Industries Limited has announced that the National Company Law Tribunal (Ahmedabad Bench) has sanctioned the Scheme of Arrangement and Amalgamation involving Triumph Offshore Private Limited and the company. The approval covers the merger and its effects on the respective shareholders and creditors of both entities.

headline: Disclosure of material issue
summary: Cellecor Gadgets Limited announced that its Board of Directors approved the migration of its equity shares from the NSE Emerge platform to the main boards of both NSE and BSE, subject to regulatory and shareholder approvals. The Board also approved the introduction of an Employee Stock Option Plan (ESOP 2026) for the grant of 50 lakh options to eligible employees. Additionally, the company approved a leadership restructuring, including the transition of Mr. Nikhil Aggarwal from Whole Time Director to National Sales Head.

headline: General Updates
summary: Religare Enterprises Limited announced that the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) has declined to grant its no-objection or prior approval for the proposed Scheme of Arrangement to demerge its undertaking into Religare Finvest Limited. This decision was communicated to both companies via letters dated August 6 and 7, 2026. REL and RFL plan to engage with the regulator to provide further clarifications on the matter.

headline: Amalgamation/Merger
summary: Ugro Capital Limited has informed the stock exchanges that the National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT), via an order dated August 6, 2026, has directed the company to convene meetings of its equity shareholders, secured creditors, and unsecured creditors. These meetings are being held to consider and approve the proposed Scheme of Amalgamation. The disclosure was made under Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Regulations.

headline: General Updates
summary: NHPC Limited has informed stock exchanges that the Ministry of Corporate Affairs has scheduled a hearing on 25.08.2026 regarding the scheme of amalgamation between its wholly-owned subsidiary, Jalpower Corporation Limited, and NHPC Limited. This update follows the company's previous communication dated 29.09.2025 and is made in compliance with SEBI regulations. Further updates on the matter will be shared in due course.

headline: Shareholders meeting
summary: Refex Industries Limited has submitted the voting results and consolidated Scrutinizer’s Report from the court-convened shareholder and creditor meetings held on August 5, 2026. These meetings were conducted to approve the Composite Scheme of Amalgamation & Arrangement involving Refex Green Mobility Limited, Refex Industries Limited, and Refex Mobility Limited. The submission marks a key procedural step in the scheme's approval process.

headline: Updates
summary: KSS Limited has informed the stock exchange about a consequential order passed by the NCLT Mumbai Bench on 5th August 2026, under Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Regulations. This order gives effect to the previously approved Resolution Plan for the company, which is undergoing the Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process.

headline: Other Restructuring
summary: Renaissance Global Limited has announced an internal corporate restructuring approved by its Board on August 7, 2026, aimed at simplifying its global footprint and optimizing its cross-border holding structure. The plan involves transferring stakes in Renaissance FMI Inc (USA) and Renaissance Global Brands Inc (USA) through share swap and purchase agreements, ultimately making RFMI a wholly-owned subsidiary of RGBI, and RGBI a wholly-owned subsidiary of Renaissance Retail Limited (India). No benefits to promoters or promoter group companies were reported from this restructuring.

headline: Amalgamation/Merger
summary: MPS Limited announced that the second step of its two-step merger became effective on 03 August 2026, with American Journal Experts, LLC, Delaware merging into MPS North America LLC. As a result, MPS North America LLC is now the surviving entity, having succeeded to all assets, rights, liabilities, and obligations of the merged company. The transaction is an intra-group restructuring involving wholly-owned subsidiaries and is exempt under Regulation 23 of the SEBI Listing Regulations.

headline: Amalgamation/Merger
summary: Intimation under Regulation 30 read with Schedule III of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulation, 2015 - Approval of Scheme of Amalgamation of Dsquare Solutions Private Limited (Step down Subsidiary) with Hansa Customer Equity Private Limited (Subsidiary Company)

headline: Amalgamation/Merger
summary: Godrej Properties Limited has received and recorded the certified order from the NCLT, Mumbai, sanctioning the Scheme of Amalgamation of Embellish Houses Private Limited with the company. The scheme was officially filed with the Registrar of Companies on August 10, 2026, making it effective, with the appointed date set as November 01, 2025.

headline: Shareholders meeting
summary: IRM Energy Limited has convened a meeting of its Unsecured Creditors on September 12, 2026, via video conferencing, to consider a Scheme of Amalgamation with Enertech Distribution Management Private Limited. The meeting is being held pursuant to orders from the National Company Law Tribunal, Ahmedabad Bench, and remote e-voting will be open from September 9 to September 11, 2026. The notice and related documents have been sent electronically to creditors and are also available on the company's website.

headline: Shareholders meeting
summary: IRM Energy Limited has informed the exchange that a Court Convened General Meeting of equity shareholders will be held on September 12, 2026, at 10:30 a.m., as per the order of the NCLT Ahmedabad. The meeting notice has been issued in accordance with the tribunal's directive.

headline: Amalgamation/Merger
summary: AvenuesAI Limited has announced the amalgamation of its wholly owned subsidiary, Nueromind Technologies Private Limited, into the parent company. The merger will see the transferor company's operations and assets consolidated under AvenuesAI Limited as the transferee entity.

headline: Outcome of Board Meeting
summary: AvenuesAI Limited's Board Meeting on August 11, 2026, approved its unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results. The board also sanctioned an increase in the investment limit, a scheme of amalgamation, changes to the Rights Issue objects, and a consolidation of equity shares. Additionally, the meeting set the date for the company's 16th Annual General Meeting.

headline: General Updates
summary: Larsen & Toubro Limited has signed a Business Transfer Agreement with its wholly owned subsidiary, Vyoma.AI Limited, along with a Share Purchase Agreement to sell its entire stake in L&T Network Services Private Limited to Vyoma. This move consolidates its network services business under Vyoma. The transaction is part of L&T's internal restructuring efforts.

headline: General Updates
summary: Hindustan Composites Limited announced that its shareholders have approved, via postal ballot, the slump sale of its Friction Business Undertaking to Rane (Madras) Limited. The transaction, valued at INR 370 crore in cash, involves a business that contributed 84% of the company's turnover in the last financial year. The sale is expected to be completed on or before 30th September, 2026.

headline: Copy of Newspaper Publication
summary: Meghmani Organics Limited has informed the stock exchange about a newspaper notice regarding the hearing of its petition for a proposed Scheme of Amalgamation. The scheme involves merging Kilburn Chemicals Limited and Meghmani Crop Nutrition Limited into Meghmani Organics Limited. The notice pertains to the interests of the shareholders and creditors of all three companies.

headline: Other Restructuring
summary: Vision Infra Equipment Solutions Limited has incorporated a new wholly owned subsidiary, Vision Infra Equipment L.L.C., in Dubai, UAE, with a capital of AED 1,00,000. The subsidiary, registered with Dubai's Department of Economy and Tourism, will operate in the construction equipment and machinery trading and rental sector. The Indian parent company holds 100% of the subsidiary's shares, which were subscribed for in cash.

headline: Copy of Newspaper Publication
summary: Timken India Limited has informed the stock exchange of newspaper publications regarding a notice of petition for the amalgamation of its wholly owned subsidiary, Timken GGB Technology Private Limited, with the company. The relevant newspaper copies are available on the company’s website for reference. The announcement serves as a formal record of this regulatory disclosure.

headline: Updates
summary: Gujarat Energy Limited has informed the stock exchange about the submission of a report from its Audit Committee and Independent Directors regarding fractional entitlements under a Scheme of Arrangement. The update pertains to the handling of fractional shares arising from the corporate restructuring.

headline: Other Restructuring
summary: Elgi Rubber Company Limited's Board approved the reversal of Rs.16.60 million in interest receivable from two overseas subsidiaries to ease their financial burden. They also approved the unaudited financial results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, which received an unmodified audit opinion. Additionally, the Board sanctioned the voluntary winding up of two dormant, non-material subsidiaries in Kenya and Australia.

headline: Amalgamation/Merger
summary: Ugro Capital Limited has received a certified copy of the NCLT order directing it to convene meetings of its equity shareholders, secured creditors, and unsecured creditors within 90 days to approve a proposed amalgamation scheme with Profectus Capital Private Limited. The meetings will be held via video conferencing or other audio-visual means, and the scheme remains subject to regulatory approvals. The company will keep stock exchanges informed of further developments.

headline: Updates
summary: Mallcom (India) Limited has received the certified copy of the NCLT Kolkata Bench order approving the Scheme of Amalgamation with its wholly-owned subsidiary, Mallcom VSFT Gloves Private Limited. The company has informed the exchange of this regulatory update.

headline: Amalgamation/Merger
summary: SecMark Consultancy Limited’s board approved a merger scheme on 12.08.2026 to amalgamate Codifi Finserv Private Limited and SecMark Holding Private Limited into the company. The move consolidates the three entities under SecMark Consultancy Limited.

headline: Outcome of Board Meeting
summary: SecMark Consultancy’s Board approved its unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, along with the limited review report. The Board also approved a scheme of amalgamation to merge Codifi Finserv Private Limited and SecMark Holding Private Limited into the company, subject to regulatory and shareholder approvals.

headline: Updates
summary: Bluspring Enterprises Limited announced that its wholly-owned subsidiary, Bluspring New Horizon One Private Limited, will be amalgamated with its step-down subsidiary, STEAG Energy Services (India) Private Limited. The merger aims to simplify the holding structure, streamline decision-making, and reduce regulatory compliances. The transaction is exempt from related party regulations and is subject to regulatory approvals.

company: The Investment Trust Of India Limited
headline: Updates
summary: The Board of The Investment Trust of India approved its unaudited financial results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, and scheduled its 35th Annual General Meeting for September 28, 2026. The company also withdrew its proposal to transfer its fund and asset management business to its subsidiary, ITI Asset Management Limited, and will continue as the Sponsor and Investment Manager for ITI Long Short Fund.

headline: Copy of Newspaper Publication
summary: DiGiSPICE Technologies Limited has informed the stock exchanges of newspaper publications regarding a hearing notice for its proposed scheme of amalgamation, involving the merger of Spice Money Limited and two other entities into DiGiSPICE. The notice was published in Business Standard and Dainik Jagran on August 14, 2026, following the directions of the National Company Law Tribunal. The company has also uploaded this intimation to its website.

headline: General Updates
summary: Banaras Beads Limited has informed the exchange that the National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT) at Allahabad issued an order on 06.08.2026 regarding pending Executive Petition EP No.424/ALD/2018 and Contempt Application No.10/2023 in CP No.14/199. The announcement provides no further details on the order's content or its impact on the company.

headline: Amalgamation/Merger
summary: Go Digit General Insurance has received NCLT approval for the first motion related to its amalgamation with Go Digit Infoworks Services. The tribunal has directed the company to convene a shareholder meeting within 90 days to approve the scheme. The merger remains subject to further statutory approvals, including from the IRDAI and shareholders.

headline: General Updates
summary: Zensar Technologies has completed all required filings for the merger of its US-based step-down subsidiary, M3BI LLC, into Zensar Technologies Inc., with the merger becoming effective on September 1, 2026. This follows the earlier completion of filings for the merger of Bridgeview Life Sciences LLC. While all requisite filings for both mergers are now done, certain post-merger and consequential filings are still in progress.

headline: Allotment of Securities
summary: Electrotherm (India) Limited has allotted 1,09,50,000 6% Non-Cumulative Redeemable Preference Shares of Rs. 10 each to its existing preference shareholders. This allotment follows the NCLT order dated July 21, 2026, and complies with Section 55(3) of the Companies Act, 2013.

headline: Amalgamation/Merger
summary: Spandana Sphoorty Financial Limited's Board approved the amalgamation of its wholly-owned subsidiary, Criss Financial Limited, into the parent company. The merger will be executed through a scheme of arrangement under the Companies Act, 2013.

headline: Copy of Newspaper Publication
summary: NHPC Limited has informed the stock exchanges about the publication of a newspaper notice regarding the hearing date for the scheme of amalgamation involving JPCL and NHPC. This follows their earlier communication dated 07.08.2026, with full details provided in the attached letter.

headline: Amalgamation/Merger
summary: GB Global Limited announced that the National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT), Mumbai Bench, has approved the Scheme of Merger by Absorption between GB Global Limited (Transferor Company) and Dev Land and Housing Private Limited (Transferee Company). The NCLT order was pronounced on August 12, 2026, and the company received the official copy on August 14, 2026. The announcement was made in compliance with SEBI Listing Regulations.

headline: General Updates
summary: Aster DM Quality Care Limited has received trading approval from NSE and BSE for 353,551,410 equity shares allotted to shareholders of the transferor company under a Scheme of Arrangement. These shares will be listed and available for trading starting Monday, 17 August 2026.

headline: Sale or disposal
summary: Blue Star Limited's wholly-owned subsidiary, Blue Star Engineering & Electronics, has signed a Business Transfer Agreement to sell its MedTech division to Cyrix Healthcare Private Limited. The sale will be executed on a slump sale basis as a going concern for a consideration of up to Rs 40 crores, with the transaction expected to be completed by March 31, 2027. The MedTech division contributed approximately 0.33% of the company's consolidated income in the last financial year.

headline: Amalgamation/Merger
summary: Birla Cable Limited has received no-objection letters from NSE and BSE regarding its proposed merger with Vindhya Telelinks Limited. The stock exchanges raised no adverse observations on the amalgamation scheme. This clears a key regulatory hurdle for the merger under the Companies Act, 2013.

headline: Amalgamation/Merger
summary: Vindhya Telelinks Limited has received no-objection letters from NSE and no adverse observations from BSE regarding its proposed amalgamation with Birla Cable Limited. The approvals pertain to the Scheme of Amalgamation under the Companies Act, 2013, involving the transfer of Birla Cable into Vindhya Telelinks. This marks a key regulatory step forward for the merger.

headline: Amalgamation/Merger
summary: Ugro Capital Limited has dispatched notices for separate meetings of its equity shareholders, secured creditors, and unsecured creditors regarding a proposed Scheme of Amalgamation. This action follows the NCLT order issued on 6th August 2026. The meetings are being convened to obtain stakeholder approvals for the merger.

headline: Updates
summary: RPG Life Sciences Limited has completed the transfer of its Active Pharmaceuticals Ingredients (API) business to its wholly owned subsidiary, RPG Active Pharma Limited, under a slump sale basis. The transaction, which follows a previously signed Business Transfer Agreement, will take effect from August 15, 2026. This update confirms the finalization of the deal as per the agreed terms.

headline: Shareholders meeting
summary: Digjam Limited held an NCLT-convened equity shareholders meeting on August 16, 2026, via video conference to seek approval for a proposed Scheme of Arrangement with Reid & Taylor International Private Limited. The meeting was chaired by an NCLT-appointed advocate, with the agenda focused on the demerger scheme under the Companies Act. The company has shared the proceedings summary on its website as per SEBI regulations.

headline: Shareholders meeting
summary: Digjam Limited has submitted the Scrutinizer’s report and voting results from its NCLT-convened General Meeting held on August 16, 2026. The submission covers both the meeting’s outcome and the detailed vote tally. This update was provided to the stock exchange as part of regulatory compliance.

headline: Demerger
summary: Piccadily Agro Industries Limited has received no adverse observations from BSE Limited and the National Stock Exchange of India, as per letters dated August 14, 2026. This clearance pertains to the company’s proposed demerger. The announcement confirms regulatory approval for the demerger process.

headline: Copy of Newspaper Publication
summary: Network18 Media & Investments has published a newspaper notice regarding the hearing and final disposal of its scheme petition for the amalgamation of its wholly owned subsidiary, News18 Marathi Private Limited, into the parent company. The announcement provides the required public notice of the legal proceedings for the merger.

headline: General Updates
summary: Varun Beverages Limited issued a general update referencing its compliance with SEBI regulations, specifically Regulation 30 and the SEBI Master Circular dated January 30, 2026. The company clarified that the required disclosure had already been provided in its earlier intimation on July 2, 2026. No new information or material event was introduced in this announcement.

headline: Acquisition
summary: Manipal Health Enterprises has signed a Business Transfer Agreement with Kindorama Healthcare to acquire the full operations of the Kinder Women’s Hospital and Fertility Centre in Bengaluru. The transaction, dated August 17, 2026, will transfer the facility’s entire operations to Manipal.

headline: Amalgamation/Merger
summary: Markolines Pavement Technologies Limited has received "No Objection" letters from both BSE and NSE regarding its proposed merger with Markolines Infra Limited. The stock exchanges have cleared the scheme for filing with the National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT), subject to certain conditions. The company will comply with all regulatory requirements and observations while proceeding with the amalgamation.

headline: General Updates
summary: RHI Magnesita India Limited announced that its wholly-owned subsidiary, Intermetal Engineers (India) Private Limited, has received regulatory approval for its merger into Ashwath Technologies Private Limited, effective 18 August 2026. As a result, Ashwath Technologies has become a direct wholly-owned subsidiary of RHI Magnesita India Limited, with new directors appointed and existing ones resigned. The merger aims to achieve operational efficiencies and rationalise the corporate structure.

headline: Sale or disposal
summary: One Mobikwik Systems Limited has completed the slump sale of its Lending Services Provider (LSP) business to its wholly-owned subsidiary, MobiKwik Distribution Services Private Limited, effective August 18, 2026. The consideration for the transfer will be settled through the issuance of Non-Convertible Debentures by the subsidiary, based on the book value of the business's assets and liabilities as of the appointed date.

headline: General Updates
summary: HEG Limited announced that the National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT), Indore Bench, has sanctioned the Composite Scheme of Arrangement involving HEG Limited, HEG Graphite Limited, and Bhilwara Energy Limited. The scheme will become effective once certified copies of the order are filed with the Registrar of Companies. The company is currently awaiting the certified copies of the NCLT order.

headline: Scheme of Arrangement
summary: HEG Limited announced that the National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT), Indore Bench, has sanctioned its Composite Scheme of Arrangement. The scheme involves HEG Limited, HEG Graphite Limited, and Bhilwara Energy Limited, along with their shareholders and creditors. This approval was granted under Sections 230 to 232 of the Companies Act, 2013.

headline: Amalgamation/Merger
summary: BLS International Services Limited announced the merger of its step-down subsidiary, BLS International Vize Hizmetleri Limited Sirketi, into another step-down subsidiary, iDATA Danismanlik Ve Hizmet Dis Tic AS, effective August 17, 2026. The transferor company will cease to exist, and no cash consideration or new shares will be issued as the merger is between two foreign subsidiaries. The rationale for the merger is to align business synergies, with no change to the listed entity's shareholding.

headline: Amalgamation/Merger
summary: Ugro Capital Limited has dispatched physical letters to equity shareholders and creditors whose email addresses are not registered, providing a weblink and QR code to access the notice and explanatory statement for meetings convened per the National Company Law Tribunal's order. These meetings, scheduled for September 22, 2026, will consider and approve the Scheme of Amalgamation of Profectus Capital Private Limited with Ugro Capital Limited. The relevant documents are also available on the company's website.

headline: Scheme of Arrangement
summary: Happiest Minds Technologies Limited announced that the National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT), Bengaluru Bench, approved its Scheme of Arrangement on August 10, 2026. The appointed date for the merger is April 1, 2026, and the company received the certified order on August 18, 2026. This disclosure was made under SEBI Listing Regulations.

headline: Amalgamation/Merger
summary: Cipla Limited announced that the National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT), Mumbai Bench, has approved the Scheme of Amalgamation of its wholly-owned subsidiary, Inzpera Healthsciences Limited, with Cipla Limited. The NCLT order, issued on 18th August 2026, allows the merger with an appointed date of 1st April 2026. The amalgamation aims to consolidate operations, improve efficiency, and enhance shareholder value.

headline: Copy of Newspaper Publication
summary: Amber Enterprises has informed the stock exchange that, per a National Company Law Tribunal order, it has published a notice regarding a scheme petition hearing scheduled for 2nd September 2026. The publication appeared in Business Standard (English) and Jansatta (Hindi) on 19th September 2026. This disclosure is made under SEBI LODR regulations.

headline: Amalgamation/Merger
summary: Ugro Capital Limited has announced the convening of separate meetings for its equity shareholders and creditors to approve a Scheme of Amalgamation with Profectus Capital Private Limited, following an NCLT order dated 6th August 2026. The company has published notices for these meetings in the Financial Express and Loksatta newspapers, as required under Regulation 30 of the Listing Regulations. The scheme aims to merge PCPL into UGRO Capital under Sections 230-232 of the Companies Act, 2013.

headline: Amalgamation/Merger
summary: Kothari Sugars and Chemicals Limited has received a no-objection letter from the National Stock Exchange regarding its proposed merger. The scheme involves the amalgamation of Kothari Sugars and Chemicals into Kothari Petrochemicals Limited.

headline: General Updates
summary: The National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT), Chennai Bench, has sanctioned the Scheme of Arrangement between TVS Holdings Limited and its shareholders under the Companies Act, 2013. The company will now take further steps to implement the scheme upon receiving the certified copy of the tribunal's order. The approval was granted following a shareholder vote where 99% of those present favoured the scheme.

headline: Amalgamation/Merger
summary: Kothari Petrochemicals Limited has received a no-objection letter from the National Stock Exchange regarding its proposed merger. The scheme involves the amalgamation of Kothari Sugars and Chemicals Limited into Kothari Petrochemicals Limited. This clears a key regulatory hurdle for the merger process.

headline: Press Release
summary: HEG Limited announced that the National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT), Indore Bench, has approved its Composite Scheme of Arrangement for the demerger of the company into two independent entities. The restructuring will separate the mature graphite electrode business from a growth-focused platform in advanced materials and renewable energy, with shareholders receiving shares in a 1:1 ratio. The scheme will become effective once the certified order is filed with the Registrar of Companies.

headline: Amalgamation/Merger
summary: EMA Partners India Limited has announced the approval of a scheme of arrangement to merge three entities—EMA Partners Executive Search, Emagine People Technologies, and EMA Decision Dynamics—into itself. The company will act as the transferee in this amalgamation.

headline: Outcome of Board Meeting
summary: EMA Partners India Limited’s Board, at its meeting on August 19, 2026, approved a scheme of arrangement to merge three entities—EMA Partners Executive Search, Emagine People Technologies, and EMA Decision Dynamics—into the company. This consolidation will make EMA Partners India the sole surviving entity.

headline: Scheme of Arrangement
summary: The National Company Law Tribunal (Allahabad Bench) has sanctioned the Scheme of Arrangement for the demerger of K.M. Sugar Mills Limited’s Distillery Division into KM Spirits and Allied Industries Limited. The order was pronounced on August 19, 2026, and the official copy is awaited for submission. This approval follows the company’s earlier intimation dated July 07, 2026, regarding the demerger under Sections 230-232 of the Companies Act, 2013.

headline: Updates
summary: India Glycols Limited has received the certified copy of the NCLT Allahabad Bench order dated 17th July 2026, which approves the Scheme of Arrangement demerging the company into Ennature Bio Pharma Limited and IGL Spirits Limited. The appointed date for the scheme is 1st April 2026, with the effective and record dates to be determined by the boards of the companies.

headline: Disclosure of material issue
summary: Hindustan Composites Limited has completed the slump sale of its Friction Business Undertaking to Rane (Madras) Limited, effective 20th August 2026. As part of the transfer, four Senior Management Personnel and the Managing Director, Mr. Pawan Kumar Choudhary, have been transferred to RML, with Mr. Choudhary resigning from his executive role while remaining a Non-Executive Director. The company has disclosed these changes to the stock exchanges in compliance with SEBI Listing Regulations.

headline: Acquisition
summary: Rane (Madras) Limited has completed the acquisition of Hindustan Composites Limited’s friction business, effective August 20, 2026. The deal was finalized after meeting all conditions precedent and customary closing terms under the Business Transfer Agreement.

headline: Updates
summary: Global Education Limited has disclosed that the Hon’ble NCLT has sanctioned the Scheme of Demerger between Yola Stays Limited and Rishiraj Infravision Private Limited. This disclosure is made under Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Regulations. The announcement confirms the regulatory approval of the demerger scheme.

headline: General Updates
summary: Share India Securities Limited has received approval from the NCLT, Ahmedabad Bench-I for the amalgamation of Silverleaf Capital Services Private Limited into the company, as per the order dated August 20, 2026. This approval marks a key regulatory step in the merger process.

headline: Record Date
summary: India Glycols Limited has fixed Tuesday, 1st September 2026, as the Effective Date and Wednesday, 2nd September 2026, as the Record Date for its demerger scheme. Under the scheme, shareholders will receive one equity share in Ennature Bio Pharma Limited for every three shares held, and one equity share in IGL Spirits Limited for every one share held. The new shares will be listed on NSE and BSE, subject to regulatory approvals.

headline: Updates
summary: NHPC Limited announced the postponement of the final hearing for the scheme of amalgamation between its wholly-owned subsidiary, Jalpower Corporation Limited, and itself. The hearing, originally scheduled for 25.08.2026, was delayed by the Ministry of Corporate Affairs due to administrative exigencies. A new date for the final hearing will be communicated in due course.

headline: General Updates
summary: Apollo Micro Systems Limited has received SEBI approval to proceed with its open offer to acquire up to 26% of Premier Explosives Limited's equity shares at INR 698 per share. The tendering period will commence within twelve working days of receiving approval from the Competition Commission of India, with payments to successful shareholders due within ten working days after the tendering period ends. Premier Explosives Limited is disseminating this information to the public as required by SEBI regulations.

headline: Updates
summary: India Glycols Limited has informed the stock exchanges of a material update concerning its subsidiary, IGL Spirits Limited, in connection with a Scheme of Arrangement. This update follows observation letters issued by the NSE and BSE in November 2025 regarding the scheme. The announcement provides regulatory clarity on the ongoing restructuring process.

headline: Updates
summary: India Glycols Limited has provided a material update to the stock exchanges regarding its subsidiary, Ennature Bio Pharma Limited, in response to observation letters from NSE and BSE. These letters, dated November 17 and 19, 2025, relate to the Scheme of Arrangement. The update addresses the exchanges' observations on this corporate restructuring.

headline: General Updates
summary: Veranda Learning Solutions Limited announced that the National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT), Chennai Bench, has sanctioned the Composite Scheme of Arrangement involving Veranda Learning Solutions, Veranda XL Learning Solutions, and J.K. Shah Commerce Education. The NCLT order was issued on August 20, 2026, and uploaded to the tribunal's website on August 21, 2026. The company will now take necessary steps to implement the scheme upon receiving the certified copy of the order.

headline: Updates
summary: The National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT) Chennai bench has admitted the application filed by Gangotri Textiles Limited under Section 10 of the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code (IBC), initiating the Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process (CIRP) against the company. The order was pronounced on August 7, 2026, following the company's own petition citing a significant debt default of over Rs. 240 crore.

headline: Shareholders meeting
summary: MPS Limited held an NCLT-convened meeting of equity shareholders on 22 August 2026 via video conferencing to seek approval for the Scheme of Amalgamation of ADI BPO Services Limited with MPS Limited. The meeting was chaired by Mr. S. C. Jain, with Mr. Kishore Prakash serving as the Scrutinizer, and included attendance from the Board of Directors and other key officials. A summary of the proceedings has been disclosed and made available on the company's website.

headline: Updates
summary: MPS Limited has disclosed the voting results and the Scrutinizer’s Report from the NCLT-convened meeting of its unsecured creditors, held on 22 August 2026. The announcement confirms the completion of the voting process as per regulatory requirements. No further details on the outcome were provided in the update.

headline: Shareholders meeting
summary: MPS Limited has disclosed the voting results and scrutinizer’s report from its NCLT-convened shareholders meeting held on 22 August 2026. The submission provides the official outcome of the votes cast during that meeting.

headline: Updates
summary: MPS Limited convened a meeting of its Unsecured Creditors on 22 August 2026, as directed by the NCLT, to seek their approval for the Scheme of Amalgamation of ADI BPO Services Limited with MPS Limited. The meeting was held via video conferencing, with Mr. S.C. Jain serving as the Chairperson and Mr. Kishore Prakash as the Scrutinizer. A summary of the proceedings has been submitted to the stock exchange and is available on the company's website.

headline: Scheme of Arrangement
summary: K.M.Sugar Mills Limited has informed the stock exchange regarding a Scheme of Arrangement. The announcement provides no further details on the nature, terms, or effective date of the scheme.

headline: Press Release
summary: Oriental Hotels Limited (OHL) announced that it will be merged with The Indian Hotels Company Limited (IHCL) via a Scheme of Arrangement, subject to statutory approvals. The all-stock transaction proposes a share exchange ratio of 25 IHCL shares for every 117 OHL shares, with an appointed date of April 1, 2027, and completion targeted for the second half of FY2028. The merger aims to simplify the group's holding structure, unlock the potential of OHL's portfolio, and drive long-term value creation for shareholders.

headline: Press Release
summary: Veranda Learning Solutions has received NCLT approval for the demerger of its Commerce vertical into J.K. Shah Commerce Education Limited (JSCEL), which will become an independently listed company. This move is part of the company's Veranda 2.0 strategy to create focused, agile education businesses, with the demerger expected to be completed within statutory timelines. Once effective, JSCEL will house all of Veranda's commerce education brands, positioning it for accelerated growth and enhanced shareholder value.

headline: Press Release
summary: The Indian Hotels Company Limited (IHCL) has announced the merger of its associate company, Oriental Hotels Limited (OHL), into itself via a Scheme of Arrangement, subject to statutory approvals. The all-stock transaction proposes a share exchange ratio of 25 IHCL shares for every 117 OHL shares, with completion targeted for the second half of FY2028. The merger aims to simplify the group's holding structure, unlock the potential of OHL's portfolio, and drive long-term value creation.

headline: Amalgamation/Merger
summary: The Indian Hotels Company Limited (IHCL) has approved a Scheme of Arrangement to amalgamate Oriental Hotels Limited (OHL) into itself, subject to regulatory and shareholder approvals. The transaction, involving a share exchange ratio based on an independent valuation, is considered a related party transaction but will be conducted on an arm's length basis. The merger is pending sanction from the National Company Law Tribunal and other statutory bodies.

headline: Amalgamation/Merger
summary: Oriental Hotels Limited (OHL) has approved a Scheme of Arrangement to amalgamate into The Indian Hotels Company Limited (IHCL), subject to shareholder, creditor, and regulatory approvals including the NCLT. The merger is a related-party transaction, as IHCL holds 37.05% of OHL, with the share exchange ratio determined on an arm's length basis via a joint valuation report. The scheme is pending final sanction and will be submitted to stock exchanges for public record.

headline: Scheme of Arrangement
summary: Dabur India Limited has provided an update on the scheme of amalgamation involving Sesa Care Private Limited. The Hon'ble National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT), New Delhi Bench, has reserved its order on the second motion petition for the scheme. The final decision from the tribunal is now pending.

headline: Scheme of Arrangement
summary: Almondz Global Securities Limited's Board approved a Scheme of Arrangement to demerge its Infrastructure Advisory Business into Almondz Global Infra – Consultant Limited, subject to regulatory and shareholder approvals. The Board also approved the notice and directors' report for FY 2025-26 and scheduled the Annual General Meeting for September 30, 2026. The demerged division's turnover for the last fiscal year was INR 292.01 Lakhs, representing 4.58% of the company's standalone total.

headline: Outcome of Board Meeting
summary: HEG Limited announced the outcomes of its Board Meeting held on August 24, 2026, covering the effective date and record date for its composite scheme of arrangement. The board also noted the certified copy of the Hon'ble NCLT order approving the scheme and reconstituted various board committees accordingly.

headline: Other Restructuring
summary: Smartworks Coworking Spaces Limited's Board has approved the appointment of two new Non-Executive Independent Directors, Mr. Dilip Deshmukh and Mr. Rajeev Krishnamuralilal Agarwal, for five-year terms, subject to member approval. The Board also approved a scheme to reduce share capital by utilizing the Securities Premium Account to fully offset accumulated losses, which will not alter the company's issued share capital or shareholder holdings. The proposal is subject to shareholder and regulatory approvals.

headline: Change in Management
summary: HEG Limited announced the cessation of its senior management personnel due to their transfer to HEG Graphite Limited. This change follows the effectiveness of the Composite Scheme of Arrangement, effective September 1, 2026.

headline: General Updates
summary: HEG Limited announced that Shri Ravi Jhunjhunwala will step down as Chairman, Managing Director & CEO, effective September 1, 2026, following the Composite Scheme of Arrangement. He will continue as a Non-Executive, Non-Independent Director, liable to retire by rotation.

headline: Agreements
summary: Aegis Vopak Terminals Limited announced that its subsidiary, Aegis Terminal (Pipavav) Limited (ATPL), has executed a Business Transfer Agreement with promoter Aegis Logistics Limited to acquire a specialized 36,000 MT ammonia storage terminal at Pipavav Port. The acquisition, valued at INR 5,250,000,000, will be funded through internal accruals or debt and adds new capacity effective August 24, 2026. The deal strengthens the group's position in ammonia storage to meet demand from fertilizer, industrial, and energy transition customers.

headline: Scheme of Arrangement
summary: Inox Green Energy Services Limited announced that its IRSL Committee has allotted 4,89,82,030 fully paid-up equity shares to eligible shareholders as per the Scheme of Arrangement. IRSL is now working to credit these shares to shareholders' demat accounts and obtain listing and trading approvals from stock exchanges.

headline: Record Date
summary: HEG Limited has fixed September 7, 2026, as the record date for determining shareholders eligible to receive consideration under its Scheme with the resulting company, HEG Graphite Limited. The date was set in consultation with HEG Graphite Limited. This applies to shareholders of HEG Limited as of that date.

headline: News Verification
summary: The stock exchange has requested clarification from Jana Small Finance Bank regarding a news report about its shares falling up to 4% amid merger speculation with Federal Bank. The company has not yet responded to the exchange's query.

headline: Updates
summary: Sonata Software Limited announced that its Scheme of Arrangement and Amalgamation with its wholly-owned subsidiary, Encore I.T. Services Solutions Private Limited, has been approved by the Registrar of Companies and became effective on 14th August, 2026. The appointed date for the scheme is 1st April, 2024. As no fresh equity shares are being issued, the company’s issued, subscribed, and paid-up capital remains unchanged.

headline: News Verification
summary: Jana Small Finance Bank Limited responded to a stock exchange query regarding a news report about its shares falling up to 4% amid merger speculation with Federal Bank. The company’s official reply to the exchange’s clarification request is attached to the announcement. No further details from the response are provided in the summary.

headline: Press Release
summary: HEG Limited announced that its demerger will take effect on September 1, 2026, with a record date fixed for September 7, 2026. The company also disclosed leadership changes that will occur as the scheme becomes effective on that date. The details were shared via a press release dated August 25, 2026.

headline: Allotment of Securities
summary: Siyaram Silk Mills Limited has allotted 181,480,352 Series I and 136,110,264 Series II Preference Shares as bonus, following a Scheme of Arrangement/Amalgamation. The allotment was approved at the company's meeting on August 25, 2026.

headline: Pendency of Litigation(s)/dispute(s) or the outcome impacting the Company
summary: Saurashtra Cement Limited has disclosed that its merged entity, Gujarat Siddhee Cement Limited, received a Show Cause Notice from the Assistant Commissioner of State Tax under the CGST and GGST Acts. The notice pertains to a tax dispute under Section 74 of these Acts. The company has provided the required details under SEBI Listing Regulations in the attached annexure.

headline: General Updates
summary: Sadbhav Engineering announced that SBI and ICICI Bank have joined its debt restructuring plan by signing a Deed of Accession to the Master Restructuring Agreement (MRA) on August 25, 2026. This agreement covers debt of Rs. 194.93 crore, with the fund-based portion to be converted into non-convertible debentures. Key terms include lender rights to appoint nominee directors and mandatory conversion of certain interest and promoter debt into equity.

headline: Corporate Debt Restructuring
summary: Sadbhav Engineering Limited announced that two additional lenders, SBI and ICICI Bank, have signed a Deed of Accession to the Master Restructuring Agreement (MRA) for its corporate debt restructuring. This agreement covers debt totaling Rs. 194.93 crore, which will be restructured, with the fund-based exposure converted into non-convertible debentures. Key terms include lenders' rights to appoint nominee directors and obligations to convert certain interest and promoter debt into equity.

headline: Acquisition
summary: Godrej Properties announced that the NCLT Mumbai Bench approved the selective reduction of equity share capital of its step-down subsidiary, Godrej Redevelopers (Mumbai) Private Limited, via an order dated August 25, 2026. This approval pertains to the acquisition-related restructuring of the subsidiary.

headline: Copy of Newspaper Publication
summary: BASF India Limited has announced a newspaper publication regarding the final hearing of its scheme petition for the demerger of its Agricultural Solutions Business into BASF Agricultural Solutions India Ltd. The notice serves to inform stakeholders of the upcoming legal proceedings. This step is part of the company's ongoing restructuring process.

company: Swan Defence and Heavy Industries Limited
headline: Amalgamation/Merger
summary: Swan Defence and Heavy Industries Limited has received the certified order from the NCLT, Ahmedabad Bench regarding the Scheme of Arrangement and Amalgamation with Triumph Offshore Private Limited. The order covers the merger of the transferor company into the transferee company, along with their respective shareholders and creditors. This marks a key regulatory approval in the amalgamation process.

headline: Other Restructuring
summary: Mankind Pharma’s Board has approved the voluntary liquidation of its wholly owned subsidiary, Bharat Serums and Vaccines Limited, as part of a restructuring move. The decision, made at today’s Board meeting, will integrate the subsidiary’s operations into the parent company. This consolidation aims to streamline corporate structure and operations.

headline: Scheme of Arrangement
summary: IRB Infrastructure Developers Limited's Board approved a Scheme of Amalgamation to merge nine of its wholly-owned subsidiaries into the parent company. The merger aims to simplify the group structure and improve operational efficiency, with no consideration payable or shares issued since the subsidiaries are wholly-owned. The scheme is subject to regulatory approvals, including from the National Company Law Tribunal.

headline: Scheme of Arrangement
summary: Devyani International's Board approved an amended Scheme of Arrangement following the termination of a Share Purchase Agreement (SPA), removing the Secondary Sale Transaction as a condition precedent to the merger. The share exchange ratio and other key terms remain unchanged, and the merger will proceed as planned. Due to the SPA termination, the post-scheme shareholding pattern has been revised, with the promoter group's stake in the merged entity decreasing to 41.99%.

headline: Scheme of Arrangement
summary: Sapphire Foods India Limited has approved a revised Scheme of Arrangement after terminating the Share Purchase Agreement (SPA), removing the Secondary Sale Transaction as a condition for the scheme's effectiveness. The share exchange ratio and other key terms remain unchanged, and the merger will proceed as planned without any impact on shareholders. The termination means the previously disclosed change in shareholding pattern due to the Secondary Sale will no longer occur.

headline: General Updates
summary: Time Technoplast Limited's Board has granted in-principle approval for the merger of its subsidiary, TPL Plastech Limited, into the parent company, subject to further approvals and the finalization of a swap ratio. The merger aims to consolidate the group structure, enhance operational efficiency, and generate synergies. Additionally, the Board has decided not to proceed with the proposed acquisition of a 74% stake in Ebullient Packaging Private Limited, as the related MoU has expired.

headline: Outcome of Board Meeting
summary: Time Technoplast Limited’s board approved the in-principle merger of its subsidiary, TPL Plastech Limited, into the parent company, subject to further approvals. The board also decided to abandon the proposed acquisition of Ebullient Packaging Private Limited. Additionally, it approved an investment in the equity shares of Time Intercontinental Limited.

headline: General Updates
summary: TVS Holdings Limited has received the certified copy of the National Company Law Tribunal (Chennai Bench) order dated 18th August 2026, which sanctions the Scheme. The company has also received the certified copy of the Scheme itself. This update confirms the formal approval of the Scheme by the Tribunal.

headline: Copy of Newspaper Publication
summary: Orient Cement Limited has informed the stock exchange that, following a tribunal order dated July 20, 2026, the notice for its equity shareholders' meeting (scheduled for September 28, 2026 via video conferencing) has been published in newspapers. The notice, which concerns the approval of a proposed Scheme, appeared in the Indian Express and Financial Express on August 27, 2026. The company has also made the documents available on its website.

headline: Copy of Newspaper Publication
summary: Ambuja Cements has published the notice for its equity shareholders' meeting, scheduled for September 28, 2026, in the Indian Express and Financial Express newspapers as per a tribunal order. The meeting will be held via video conferencing to consider and approve a proposed scheme of arrangement. The company has also made these documents available on its website.

headline: Other Restructuring
summary: Cipla announced a restructuring where Aspergen Limited, India, its 60:40 joint venture with Kemwell Biopharma, acquired 100% of Aspergen Inc., USA, from Cipla (EU) Limited and Kemwell Biopharma UK Limited. As a result, Aspergen Inc. is now a wholly owned subsidiary of Aspergen Limited, India. The move aims to rationalise the group structure, with no change to Cipla's economic interest in the US entity.

headline: General Updates
summary: Gujarat Energy Limited has informed the exchange about an email update sent to eligible shareholders of GSPC and GSPL regarding the distribution of sale proceeds from fractional entitlements. This communication is part of the ongoing implementation of the Scheme of Arrangement. The update pertains specifically to the allocation of funds for these fractional shares.

headline: Shareholders meeting
summary: ACC Limited has informed the stock exchange about a shareholders' meeting convened as per the National Company Law Tribunal (Ahmedabad Bench) order. The meeting pertains to the proposed Scheme of Amalgamation of ACC Limited with Ambuja Cements Limited.

headline: Disclosure of material issue
summary: LIC Housing Finance clarified that media reports about an NCLT order in Dr. Subhash Chandra's personal insolvency case do not affect its rights, as it continues to hold and enforce security interests over the secured assets backing its loans. The company confirmed it has an admitted claim of ₹322.39 crore in the proceedings, against which the repayment plan offers only ₹38.09 lakh. LICHFL emphasized that the NCLT order pertains solely to the personal guarantor and does not impact the corporate liabilities of the principal borrower entities.

headline: Other Restructuring
summary: Osel Devices Limited's Board approved the re-appointment of its Managing Director and Whole-time Director for three-year terms, alongside the regularisation of an Independent Director. The Board also sanctioned a merger of its subsidiary with a step-down subsidiary, material related party transactions up to ₹50 crore, and an increase in authorised share capital. Additionally, the CFO resigned due to maternity, and the company's Annual General Meeting was scheduled for September 25, 2026.

headline: Copy of Newspaper Publication
summary: ACC Limited has informed the stock exchange about a newspaper publication regarding the dispatch of notices for an NCLT-convened meeting. This meeting pertains to the proposed amalgamation of ACC Limited with Ambuja Cements Limited. The notice marks a procedural step in the merger process.

headline: Copy of Newspaper Publication
summary: Ambuja Cements has informed the stock exchanges that, following a tribunal order, it has published the notice for its equity shareholders' meeting scheduled for September 29, 2026, in the Indian Express and Financial Express newspapers. The meeting will be held via video conferencing to consider and approve a proposed scheme of arrangement. Copies of the newspaper advertisements have been enclosed and are also available on the company's website.

headline: Amalgamation/Merger
summary: Aster DM Quality Care Limited announced the amalgamation of its step-down subsidiary, KIMSHEALTH Executive Leisure Private Limited, into another step-down subsidiary, Spiceretreat Hospitality Services Private Limited. The merger is part of an internal restructuring within the company's subsidiary framework. The announcement was made to inform the exchange of this corporate action.

headline: Amalgamation/Merger
summary: PPAP Automotive Limited has scheduled a meeting of its unsecured creditors for September 30, 2026, via video conferencing, as directed by the NCLT. This meeting is part of the proposed Scheme of Amalgamation of Avinya Batteries Limited into PPAP Automotive Limited. Creditors can vote remotely from September 26 to 29, 2026, with voting rights based on outstanding amounts as of the March 31, 2026 cutoff date.

headline: Amalgamation/Merger
summary: PPAP Automotive Limited has scheduled a meeting of its secured creditors for September 30, 2026, via video conferencing, as directed by the NCLT. This meeting is part of the scheme to amalgamate Avinya Batteries Limited with PPAP Automotive. Remote e-voting for the creditors will be open from September 26 to September 29, 2026.

headline: Amalgamation/Merger
summary: PPAP Automotive Limited has scheduled a shareholder meeting for September 30, 2026, via video conferencing, to approve the amalgamation of Avinya Batteries Limited into the company, as ordered by the NCLT. Only shareholders on the record as of May 22, 2026, are eligible to vote, with remote e-voting available from September 26 to 29, 2026. The official notice has been dispatched to eligible shareholders and is also available on the company's website.

headline: Amalgamation/Merger
summary: Muthoot Finance's Board has approved a scheme to amalgamate its wholly-owned subsidiary, Muthoot Money Limited, into the parent company. The merger is subject to approvals from the NCLT, RBI, and other regulatory bodies. The move consolidates the two gold loan-focused NBFCs, with Muthoot Money having total assets of Rs. 10,344.92 crores as of March 31, 2026.

headline: Copy of Newspaper Publication
summary: Hubtown Limited has announced that its scheme petition for the merger of 25 West Realty Private Limited with the company has been admitted by the relevant authority. The final hearing for the scheme’s sanction is scheduled for September 10, 2026. This information was shared via a newspaper publication.

headline: Other Restructuring
summary: NIIT Learning Systems Limited announced the voluntary dissolution and winding up of its step-down subsidiary, MST Shanghai Co. Limited, effective August 31, 2026. The move, subject to regulatory approvals, is aimed at streamlining the corporate structure and will not materially impact the company's operations or financials.

headline: General Updates
summary: Veranda Learning Solutions Limited announced that the National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT) sanctioned its Scheme of Amalgamation and Demerger, with the certified order received and filed with the Registrar of Companies on August 31, 2026. This date marks the Effective Date and First Appointed Date, completing the amalgamation of VXLS into VLS, which increased VLS's authorised share capital to INR 147.50 crore. The demerger of the Commerce Business to JSCEL takes effect on the Second Appointed Date, September 01, 2026.

headline: Scheme of Arrangement
summary: Happiest Minds Technologies' Board has approved a scheme of amalgamation with ITC Infotech India Limited, subject to regulatory approvals. Under the scheme, Happiest Minds shareholders will receive 25 ITC Infotech shares for every 81 shares held, and ITC Infotech shares will be listed on stock exchanges. The company also approved a related Merger Framework Agreement to execute the transaction.

headline: Press Release (Revised)
summary: Happiest Minds Technologies announced a revised press release regarding its merger with ITC Infotech. The combined entity aims to become a scaled, AI-first global technology services company. The merger targets US$ 1 billion in revenue by FY28.

headline: Demerger
summary: Lux Industries Limited's Board has approved a demerger scheme, splitting its Vertical A and Vertical C business undertakings into two separate companies: Lux and Cozi Limited and Lux Global Limited. Shareholders will receive one equity share in each new company for every share held in Lux Industries, maintaining identical shareholding. The scheme is subject to regulatory and shareholder approvals, with the new shares to be listed on BSE and NSE.

headline: Press Release
summary: Happiest Minds Technologies announced a merger with ITC Infotech, aiming to create a larger, AI-first global technology services company. The combined entity targets US$1 billion in revenue by fiscal year 2028. The announcement was made via a press release dated August 31, 2026.

headline: Updates
summary: Thyrocare Technologies has informed the exchange of a communication from API Holdings regarding the approval of a scheme to amalgamate Docon Technologies Private Limited with API Holdings. The announcement provides no further details or impact on Thyrocare itself.

headline: General Updates
summary: ITC Limited announced that the Scheme of Amalgamation of its step-down subsidiaries, Blazeclan Technologies Private Limited and Cloudlytics Technologies Private Limited, with its wholly-owned subsidiary ITC Infotech India Limited has been sanctioned by the National Company Law Tribunal. The scheme became effective on 1st September, 2026, with an appointed date of 1st October, 2024. Consequently, both Blazeclan and Cloudlytics have been dissolved without winding up and have ceased to be subsidiaries of the company.

headline: Updates
summary: India Glycols Limited has announced that its demerger into three separate entities—India Glycols Limited, IGL Spirits Limited, and Ennature Bio Pharma Limited—became effective on September 1, 2026, following the filing of the NCLT order with the Registrar of Companies. As a result, the resulting companies have ceased to be subsidiaries of the original entity. Shareholders will receive shares in the new entities based on their holdings as of the record date, with each company focusing on distinct business segments.

headline: General Updates
summary: Thomas Cook (India) Limited has informed the stock exchanges about receiving an observation letter from SEBI regarding its composite scheme, in compliance with Regulation 37 of the SEBI Listing Regulations. The letter is available on the company’s website and has been submitted for the record.

headline: Scheme of Arrangement
summary: Go Digit General Insurance Limited has received the detailed order from the Competition Commission of India (CCI) approving its proposed Scheme of Amalgamation with Go Digit Infoworks Services Private Limited. This approval follows the initial CCI clearance communicated in July 2026. The scheme is still subject to further approvals from the NCLT, IRDAI, and shareholders.

headline: General Updates
summary: L&T Technology Services has completed the sale of its Smart World and Communication Business Unit to AMI Paradigm Solutions Private Limited, as per the Business Transfer Agreement. The transaction has been finalized and communicated to the stock exchange.

headline: Amalgamation/Merger
summary: KFin Technologies' Board approved a composite scheme to amalgamate its wholly-owned subsidiaries, WebileApps and Hexagram, along with step-down subsidiary WebileApps Tech, into the parent company. The merger aims to streamline the group structure and is subject to statutory approvals, including sanction from the National Company Law Tribunal. The transaction is not classified as a related party transaction under applicable regulations.

headline: Scheme of Arrangement
summary: Larsen & Toubro Limited announced that the National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT) has admitted its petition seeking sanction for a Scheme of Arrangement with L&T Realty Properties Limited. The Tribunal has scheduled the hearing of the petition for October 6, 2026. This follows the earlier direction to convene shareholder meetings and notify creditors, as per the Companies Act provisions.

headline: Acquisition
summary: Premier Energies Limited's Board approved the incorporation of a wholly-owned subsidiary in Singapore, PE Horizon Pte. Ltd., for clean energy trading and consulting, with an overseas investment of up to SGD 1,00,000. The Board also approved an intra-group reorganization where its entire stake in Premier Energies Storage Solutions will be transferred to Premier Battery Technologies via a share swap, making the former a step-down subsidiary. The transaction is a related party deal approved by the Audit Committee, with no change in ultimate ownership.

headline: General Updates
summary: Rashi Peripherals Limited has completed the transaction under the Business Transfer Agreement dated August 31, 2026, with Rashi Semiconductor Solutions Private Limited as the purchaser. All conditions precedent and requirements under the agreement have been fulfilled, and the transaction has been finalized as per the agreed terms. This update follows the company's earlier intimation on August 4, 2026, and is disclosed under SEBI LODR regulations.

headline: General Updates
summary: Thomas Cook (India) Limited has received an observation letter from SEBI regarding its draft composite Scheme of Arrangement involving several group companies. SEBI has provided specific comments and conditions, including compliance with LODR regulations, disclosure of ongoing legal proceedings, and adherence to master circulars. The company has shared this letter with the stock exchange and uploaded it to its website for public record.

headline: General Updates
summary: RPG Life Sciences' board approved a Business Transfer Agreement for its wholly-owned subsidiary, RPG Active Pharma Limited, to acquire the API and intermediates business of Raghava Life Sciences Private Limited via a slump sale. The transaction, valued at up to Rs. 135 crores, includes manufacturing and R&D facilities along with a portfolio of 29 API molecules, and is expected to be completed within approximately 30 days. This acquisition aligns with the company's strategy to expand its API business and is not a related party transaction.

headline: Scheme of Arrangement
summary: MSP Steel & Power Limited's Board has approved a draft Scheme of Arrangement for the demerger of MSP Sponge Iron Limited's manufacturing business into MSP Steel, subject to regulatory approvals. The Board also approved the company's annual report, the notice for the AGM scheduled for September 30, 2026, and the appointments of internal and cost auditors for the 2026-2027 fiscal year.
